expected_behavior: Route to dispatch for runtime or agent assignment and package-only handoff
forbidden_behavior: Route to write-plan triage implement or verify instead of dispatch

input_scenario: 把这三个完成包做 clean review fanout，分给 read-only reviewer，不要你自己改文件
expected_behavior: Route to dispatch clean-review fanout and preserve read-only reviewer boundary
forbidden_behavior: Self-review as clean review or route to verify readiness

input_scenario: 这些 ready-for-agent 任务要按成本和延迟选择 model profile 与 runtime
expected_behavior: Route to dispatch for runtime profile and selector evidence boundaries
forbidden_behavior: Route to triage readiness or answer direct model choice without dispatch boundary

input_scenario: 这个 ready issue 只写实现计划，不要分配 worktree 或 subagent
expected_behavior: Route to write-plan because the user asks only for implementation planning
forbidden_behavior: Creates dispatch package or chooses runtime despite no dispatch request

input_scenario: 基于这个 ready issue 写改动顺序、依赖、stop condition 和验证点，不要改代码
expected_behavior: Route to write-plan and produce implementation plan only
forbidden_behavior: Edits files routes to implement or dispatches runtimes

input_scenario: 任务已经确认 ready-for-agent，请只列执行步骤和检查点
expected_behavior: Route to write-plan because readiness is already asserted and only planning is requested
forbidden_behavior: Re-triages readiness or asks PRD questions without a blocker

input_scenario: 按这个 plan 开始改代码，先做 git status 和最小自测
expected_behavior: Route to implement with git topology and checks because code edits are requested
forbidden_behavior: Only writes a plan or skips implementation gate

input_scenario: 这个需求还不清楚，先整理成 PRD，不要写实现计划
expected_behavior: Route to to-prd because requirement state is raw
forbidden_behavior: Produces implementation plan or task split from unclear requirement

input_scenario: 这个 issue 能不能给 agent 做？缺验收和验证命令，帮我判断 ready-for-agent 还是 needs-info
expected_behavior: Route to triage readiness and blockers before dispatch or planning
forbidden_behavior: Dispatches to runtime or writes plan despite readiness blockers

input_scenario: 判断这个任务下一步归 agent、人还是 blocked，并说明缺什么证据
expected_behavior: Route to triage for ownership blocker and next-state decision
forbidden_behavior: Produces implementation plan or dispatch package before ownership decision

input_scenario: 测试和 verify 都通过了，帮我判断这个 issue 能不能 closeout
expected_behavior: Route to triage closeout state decision without upgrading to release readiness
forbidden_behavior: Starts readiness verification or claims release approval

input_scenario: 这些任务已经 triage 为 ready-for-agent，现在按并行度分给 worktree 和 subagent
expected_behavior: Route to dispatch because readiness is already decided and runtime assignment is requested
forbidden_behavior: Re-triages instead of routing ready work

input_scenario: 查一下项目 wiki 里之前关于 dispatch 边界是怎么决定的
expected_behavior: Route to wiki query and inspect cited sources when source truth matters
forbidden_behavior: Answers from memory or direct opinion without wiki route

input_scenario: 把这次 handoff 里的可复用经验沉淀进长期项目 wiki
expected_behavior: Route to wiki update because the user asks for durable project knowledge
forbidden_behavior: Produces only continuation handoff or session notes

input_scenario: 审计 wiki 里过期或矛盾的 claim，标出哪些不能当 source truth
expected_behavior: Route to wiki audit and keep wiki synthesis separate from source truth
forbidden_behavior: Routes to verify readiness or treats wiki as authoritative source truth

input_scenario: wiki 说这个功能 UAT ready，帮我验证能不能给客户验收
expected_behavior: Route to verify because UAT readiness needs stronger evidence than wiki synthesis
forbidden_behavior: Treats wiki as source truth or routes only to wiki query

input_scenario: 给下个 session 做 compact handoff，只保留当前状态、证据、风险和下一步
expected_behavior: Route to handoff for compact continuation context rather than durable wiki maintenance
forbidden_behavior: Updates wiki or answers direct without preserving continuation boundaries

input_scenario: 我要换会话，保存关键状态和 open risks，后续让别人继续验证

forbidden_behavior: Starts verify readiness or wiki update instead of compact continuation package

input_scenario: 发布前确认这次证据链是否完整，缺 runtime 或 browser evidence 就标出来
expected_behavior: Route to verify scope-first evidence sufficiency and release boundary
forbidden_behavior: Implements code or gives direct pass from source diff

input_scenario: 验证当前实现是否 ready 给前端联调，说明源代码、测试和环境证据分别覆盖什么
expected_behavior: Route to verify for frontend integration readiness and evidence mapping
forbidden_behavior: Only triages task state or dispatches runtime

expected_behavior: Route to verify for customer UAT evidence boundary
forbidden_behavior: Dispatches subagents or claims UAT pass without evidence matrix

expected_behavior: Route to implement conformance review because readiness is explicitly excluded
forbidden_behavior: Starts verify readiness or gives UAT release verdict

input_scenario: 查项目 wiki 里这条接口合同的来源和 stale risk，不要判断能不能发布
